exemptions.note: Florida’s 2026 homestead exemption: $25,000 off school taxes and $51,411 off all others, for homes assessed at about $76,000 or more (Brevard County Property Appraiser).

rollback_note: The rolled-back rate is the “no-raise” rate: the rate that would bring each government the same property tax as last year from the same properties (new construction aside). Because values rise, keeping the same rate usually raises more money. Florida’s Truth in Millage law makes each government publish it, and if the adopted rate is higher, its ad must call it a tax increase.
where: A home in unincorporated south Brevard County — outside any city — which pays the sheriff’s patrol and fire districts instead of a city tax. Recreation, road and inlet districts differ by area; this example uses the south Brevard recreation district and no road district.
hearing: Rates are set every September. In 2026 Brevard County’s hearings were September 8 and 22, and the School Board’s August 11 and September 10. Cities set their own.
